caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bed frame with a brown coloration. The bed has two headboards at either end, each with a curved and decorative cut at the top edges. There are four legs, two at each end, with the legs on the right side appearing thicker and rounded, while the left-side legs are slimmer and straight. The side rails are rectangular and connect the headboards, forming a box structure. The surface inside the frame shows a series of evenly spaced rectangular wooden slats that sit horizontally, suggesting support for a mattress. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or decorations, and there is a small handwritten label that reads “Rose River” beneath the bed on the left side.
title: Day Bed
